title: cheilanthes pedata
intro: Cheilanthes pedata, commonly known as Rock fern or Palmate Lip fern, is a species of fern in the family Woodsiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and soothing digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes pedata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful for wound healing and immune system support. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
